author: Ciara Kennelly
text:
I had the most fantastic experience at this Thermomix demo! Monia was absolutely wonderful—so warm, knowledgeable, and engaging from start to finish. She walked us through all the features of the Thermomix in such a clear and easy-to-understand way, making it feel incredibly accessible.

She prepared three different dishes for us, along with a delicious cocktail, and everything tasted amazing—honestly better than I expected! What really stood out was how fun and interactive she made the whole experience. It didn’t feel like a typical demo at all—it was relaxed, enjoyable, and genuinely inspiring.

I left feeling excited and confident about using the Thermomix. Huge thanks to Monia for such a memorable experience. Highly recommend to anyone considering it! ✨

text: Monika was so attentive and supportive from placing my TM7 order through to helping me get up and running in my home. Very positive experience with my TM7 and already delighted I made the investment.
